gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings,' the guard warned us.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with not + to-infinitive: warned us not to touch.

gaps.sentence: They announced that ___ selling the house.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were selling.

gaps.lead: The mechanic is servicing my car tomorrow.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.

gaps.lead: He'd rather not discuss the matter.
gaps.explanation: would prefer + not + to-infinitive: prefer not to discuss.

gaps.lead: 'I'll finish the essay by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: was unable to = couldn't (general ability in the past).
